name: kql-multi-hop
description: Multi-hop quantifiers {n}, {m,n}, {0}, {m,}: forward and reverse traversal, directionality, out-of-range ranges, the zero-hop reflexive match, and the errors for an unanchored or over-cap traversal.
setup: UPSERT { CONCEPT ?drug_type { {type: "$ConceptType", name: "Drug"} SET ATTRIBUTES { "description": "Pharmaceutical drug concept type" } } WITH METADATA { "source": "test_setup", "confidence": 1.0 } }

UPSERT { CONCEPT ?symptom_type { {type: "$ConceptType", name: "Symptom"} SET ATTRIBUTES { "description": "Medical symptom concept type" } } WITH METADATA { "source": "test_setup", "confidence": 1.0 } }
UPSERT { CONCEPT ?treats_pred { {type: "$PropositionType", name: "treats"} SET ATTRIBUTES { "description": "Treatment relationship" } } WITH METADATA { "source": "test_setup", "confidence": 1.0 } }
UPSERT { CONCEPT ?headache { {type: "Symptom", name: "Headache"} SET ATTRIBUTES { "severity": "moderate", "duration": "2-4 hours" } } WITH METADATA { "source": "test_data", "confidence": 1.0 } }
UPSERT { CONCEPT ?fever { {type: "Symptom", name: "Fever"} SET ATTRIBUTES { "temperature_range": "38-40°C", "common": true } } WITH METADATA { "source": "test_data", "confidence": 0.9 } }

UPSERT { CONCEPT ?aspirin { {type: "Drug", name: "Aspirin"} SET ATTRIBUTES { "molecular_formula": "C9H8O4", "risk_level": 2, "dosage": "325mg" } SET PROPOSITIONS { ("treats", {type: "Symptom", name: "Headache"}) ("treats", {type: "Symptom", name: "Fever"}) } } } WITH METADATA { "source": "test_data", "confidence": 0.95 }

UPSERT { CONCEPT ?category_type { {type: "$ConceptType", name: "Category"} } CONCEPT ?person_type { {type: "$ConceptType", name: "Person"} } CONCEPT ?is_subclass_of_pred { {type: "$PropositionType", name: "is_subclass_of"} } CONCEPT ?belongs_to_pred { {type: "$PropositionType", name: "belongs_to"} } CONCEPT ?knows_pred { {type: "$PropositionType", name: "knows"} } CONCEPT ?medicine { {type: "Category", name: "Medicine"} } CONCEPT ?pain_reliever { {type: "Category", name: "PainReliever"} SET PROPOSITIONS { ("is_subclass_of", {type: "Category", name: "Medicine"}) } } CONCEPT ?nsaid { {type: "Category", name: "NSAID"} SET PROPOSITIONS { ("is_subclass_of", {type: "Category", name: "PainReliever"}) } } CONCEPT ?aspirin_category { {type: "Drug", name: "Aspirin"} SET PROPOSITIONS { ("belongs_to", {type: "Category", name: "NSAID"}) } } CONCEPT ?alice { {type: "Person", name: "Alice"} } CONCEPT ?bob { {type: "Person", name: "Bob"} SET PROPOSITIONS { ("knows", {type: "Person", name: "Alice"}) } } CONCEPT ?charlie { {type: "Person", name: "Charlie"} SET PROPOSITIONS { ("knows", {type: "Person", name: "Bob"}) } } CONCEPT ?david { {type: "Person", name: "David"} SET PROPOSITIONS { ("knows", {type: "Person", name: "Charlie"}) } } }

UPSERT { CONCEPT ?cat_a { {type: "Category", name: "CatA"} } CONCEPT ?cat_b { {type: "Category", name: "CatB"} SET PROPOSITIONS { ("is_subclass_of", ?cat_a) } } CONCEPT ?cat_c { {type: "Category", name: "CatC"} SET PROPOSITIONS { ("is_subclass_of", ?cat_b) } } }

cases.name: chained patterns equi-join per solution across a 1..3 hop walk
cases.command: FIND(?drug.name, ?category.name, ?parent_category.name) WHERE { ?drug {type: "Drug", name: "Aspirin"} (?drug, "belongs_to", ?category) (?category, "is_subclass_of"{1,3}, ?parent_category) } ORDER BY ?parent_category.name ASC

cases.name: a bound object endpoint walks the relation backwards
a reverse walk composes with an ordinary pattern
an exact hop count matches only that depth
a three-hop chain is reachable within {1,3}
traversal is directed, so the reverse chain has no solution
a zero-hop quantifier matches the anchor itself
an unbounded {1,} closure that completes within the cap
a lower bound beyond the actual path length empties the whole solution set
a multi-hop pattern needs at least one grounded endpoint

error.message: cannot both be variables in multi-hop matching

cases.name: an explicit upper bound beyond the engine cap is rejected, not truncated
an unbounded quantifier whose lower bound exceeds the cap is rejected
a non-offset CURSOR on a multi-hop page is rejected
